title: EMOSA fleet status
description: The serving fleet's ports (spec 4): RUN_ROOT/fleet-status.json (STATE_ROOT/fleet-status.json without a run root), written at its start and then at most once a second while anything changes. Read-only for observers; never contains secrets.

agent_ports.description: The configuration's ports: first and last agent port.

reserved_ports.description: The reserved ports in effect (reserved_ports), sorted: never allocated, adopted, listened on or forwarded.

reserved_from.description: Where they come from: the configuration's reserved_ports, the build's default (the C fleet's EMOSA_RESERVED_PORTS) or none.

assigned.description: The agent ports the registry's entries hold, sorted.

reserved_assigned.description: Those of them that are reserved: each entry's agent is not started, and the entry moves at its pod's next arrival. Empty when all is well.

listening.description: The free agent ports the fleet listens on for re-admission (on loopback), sorted.

cannot_listen.description: Free agent ports it could not listen on (another program's there), sorted.

unidentified_connections.description: Connections, at the front port or an agent port, that ended before the pod identified itself, since the fleet started (logged at most once a minute).
